description: Users say updates have made the app harder to use, especially by limiting control over songs and personal playlists or removing familiar features.
name: App usability and feature changes

description: Users report songs playing unexpectedly or not playing at all, and playback stopping when they switch to other apps.
name: Unreliable music playback

description: Users object to unexpected charges and to core features becoming unavailable after a premium subscription ends or without paying.
name: Charges and premium restrictions

description: General dissatisfaction with the app or its updates without a specific problem identified.
name: General dissatisfaction

description: Users have difficulty searching for music, browsing genres, and discovering or revisiting content through the interface.
name: Finding and discovering music

description: Users cannot log in or access their accounts, sometimes after an error or app loading failure.
name: Account access and login problems

description: Users report lost downloads and playlists, problems playing music offline, and downloaded or local files disappearing or becoming inaccessible.
name: Downloads and offline listening problems

description: Users are disappointed with customer service responses and the handling of questions or eligibility concerns.
name: Customer support concerns
